## CommandInventory interface

Represented command sites and interpretation limits observed in one syntax subtree. A command list does not prove execution completeness when uncertainties are present; even an uncertainty-free result describes syntax under this analyzer's assumptions.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface CommandInventory
```
